title: The master keeps durable lessons it reads on every launch
description: Runs the real master-session launch against the executable credential-free runtime fixture through a stub Herdr, after `master lesson add` recorded lessons in project memory: the next launch prompt contains them, a lesson added --for workers reaches a worker's prompt and one without it does not, the 41st lesson drops the oldest, remove deletes by id, and a worker identity is refused. No provider credentials, accounts or network.

steps.name: master lessons recorded, carried and bounded
